page.notes: The woodcut initial is a V-shaped capital, read as the initial of the first word "Uxorem" (printed "Xorem"). Printed u/v spelling changed as per the rules. Three small ornamental marks stand in the right margin at the height of the text lines; these are not text, so no notes are transcribed. A small "O" appears alone below the last line, in the right-hand area; it is not a word, so it is left out. The line "alie-" ends a word with a printed hyphen; the rest of the word is on the next page. The "f" in "Ecclef." is the long s and is read as "Eccles.".
